engine.validated_by: Build6739 offline review against the 6731 engine block. MSVC x64 RTTI (vtable-8 -> COL -> TypeDescriptor+0x10) locates CDemoPlayer (vtable 0x4d7e88, COL 0x53bad8), CDemoFile (0x4d7fe0, COL 0x53bb78), CEngineClient (0x4e2790, COL 0x540a58) and CNetworkClientService (0x51fa00, COL 0x554638); every reviewed accessor is re-read from its 6731 slot on those vtables and matches the 6731 first16 masked for RIP/rel32 operands and the full reviewed CFG. Eleven accessors also keep the exact 6731 RVA; network_service_get_tick moved 0x1d4e10 -> 0x1d4e90 because its vtable shifted +0x18 (function bytes unchanged). Pointer globals are resolved from RIP displacements in those exact functions/constructors: demo_player_pointer 0x5b92b0 (file qword -> base+0x631d78; CDemoPlayer static constructor at 0x2d5aa..0x2d5b3 writes vtable 0x4d7e88 into 0x631d78), network_client_service_pointer 0x62e698 (demo_get_tick 0x34ee9 loads it, then calls slot 57) and aspect_cvar_object 0x633c00 (both leas in engine_get_aspect_ratio 0x73694/0x736a8 point at it; the r_aspectratio ConVar registration cluster near 0x5210 references it, string at 0x4e2378). No anchor needed a guess; nothing is unresolved.
notes: Except network_service_get_tick, every reviewed accessor keeps both its 6731 RVA and its first16 bytes; CDemoPlayer/CEngineClient/CDemoFile did not move.

network_client_service_vtable is 0x51fa00, +0x18 from the 6731 value 0x51f9e8. RTTI gives CNetworkClientService first slot 0x51fa00 and slot 57 (0x1d4e90) has the reviewed network_service_get_tick CFG (mov eax,[rcx+0x90]; ret); 0x51f9e8 is mid-vtable in 6739.
demo_player_default_object 0x631d78 lies in .data BSS (zero in file); the pointer global 0x5b92b0 already holds base+0x631d78 and the CDemoPlayer static constructor writes the vtable into it at load.

network_client_service_pointer 0x62e698 and aspect_cvar_object 0x633c00 are BSS globals; they are anchored through RIP-relative references in reviewed accessors and the r_aspectratio registration code, not through file bytes.
